brief:
A top United Nations Development Programme official said Gaza's suffering "must compel us to ask difficult questions," according to Middle East Eye. The statement signals internal reflection within the UN body on its role and response to the humanitarian crisis in the territory.

The official did not specify which questions require examination, but the remark suggests the UNDP is confronting broader implications of the Gaza situation for development work and international intervention strategies.
dek: UNDP official: 'Gaza's suffering must compel us to ask difficult questions' A top United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) official has said the suffering endured by people in Gaza "must compel us to ask difficult questions".
title: UNDP official calls Gaza suffering catalyst for difficult questions
